LAW AND MOTION 301, PLAINTIFFS AND CROSS-DEFENDANTS PLANT'IT EARTH, LLC, AND BROOKE TAGGART'S MOTION FOR SUMMARY JUDGMENT OR IN THE ALTERNATIVE SUMMARY ADJUDICATION OF THEIR COMPLAINT AND RANDOLPH'S CROSS-COMPLAINT. MOTION FOR SUMMARY JUDGMENT IS GRANTED. THE COURT FINDS THAT THOSE CAUSES OF ACTION ATTACKED ON STATUTE OF LIMITATION ARE PROPER. THOSE CLAIMS ARE PROPERLY ADJUDICATED. THE PLAINTIFF BY ADMISSIBLE EVIDENCE SHOWED THE DEFENDANT CANNOT PROVE THE EXISTENCE OF A WRITTEN CONTRACT. WITH THE CONTRACT AND FRAUD CLAIMS OUT OF THE CASE, THERE IS NOTHING LEFT TO THE REMAINING CLAIMS. SUMMARY JUDGMENT IS GRANTED AS TO THE COMPLAINT AS WELL. MS. LAURENT IS TO SUBMIT A PROPOSED FORM OF ORDER PURSUANT TO CCP 437 C(G). JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, REPORTER: CAROL KAREN, CSR# 8189
